definition: Yan Junjie (Chinese: 闫俊杰; pinyin: Yán Jùnjié; born 1989) is a Chinese businessman and the co-founder and chief executive officer of the artificial intelligence (AI) company MiniMax Group.
details: Yan Junjie (Chinese: 闫俊杰; pinyin: Yán Jùnjié; born 1989) is a Chinese businessman and the co-founder and chief executive officer of the artificial intelligence (AI) company MiniMax Group.

explainer.lead: Yan Junjie is a Chinese businessman (born 1989). His work spans artificial intelligence.

timeline.what: He attended Southeast University graduating in 2006 with a degree in mathematics.
He obtained a PhD from the Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences in 2015.

affiliations: Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences
